title: a value flag takes the next word as its value even when it looks like a flag
source: cli/jitso/launch.ts: parseLaunchArgs (the value is argv[i+1], whatever it is)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). A value flag takes the next word as its value even when it looks like a flag, so `launch --build --dry-run ...` takes `--dry-run` as the build id and is rejected with `invalid value for --build`. The oracle still prints `invalid value for --preset`, so the stderr expectation FAILS on TS.
